question: A person is watching TV on the sofa. Which of the following statements is correct?
question_full:
A person is watching TV on the sofa. Which of the following statements is correct?
Options: A: If he walks to the right and back, he can see two sofa chairs. B: If he walks to the right, he cannot see the mural. C: If he wants to get a book from the round table surrounded by four types of chairs, he should walk to the left and forward. D: If he wants to leave the living room, he should walk to the left.
choices: A. If he walks to the right and back, he can see two sofa chairs.
B. If he walks to the right, he cannot see the mural.
C. If he wants to get a book from the round table surrounded by four types of chairs, he should walk to the left and forward.
D. If he wants to leave the living room, he should walk to the left.
